Our divisions

One group, three specialised businesses

Vega's operates a consumer and commercial distribution business, a Belizean bleach manufacturer and a lubricants distributor. Each serves a different customer need from the same Benque Viejo base.

Consumer and commercial product distribution

Vega's Distributors Ltd.

The parent distribution business, supplying supermarkets, wholesalers and commercial customers across Belize with established consumer brands and locally manufactured products.

Oils and lubricants for vehicles, equipment, industry and marine use

International Lubricants of Belize Ltd.

ILB distributes oils and lubricants across Belize for commercial transportation, industrial and off-highway equipment, passenger vehicles and marine use.

  • Heavy-duty motor oils
  • Coolants and antifreeze
  • Greases
  • Hydraulic fluids
  • Gear lubricants
